reply: You cannot review 31 like this, and you should not have to. I asked the retrospective to check each of the 31 against main's decisions and the other rulings: which are new, which repeat something already ruled, which conflict. I will bring you only the ones that conflict or change a rule, in a few lines. The rest stand as filed; none of them blocks work. This item stays open until that check is back.
title: Do you confirm these 31 rulings, which came from coordinator, lane or triage picks and not your own words?
why: Coordinator asked for one confirm-or-overturn item; none blocking.
